ecosystemsTeam.name: LightSpeed Holdings Ecosystems Team
ecosystemsTeam.description: Cross-functional team orchestrating all third-party integrations for LightSpeed Holdings Limited: strategic partnerships, client-facing system connectors (Offer B/C), and vendor/contract management.

orchestrator.name: Head of Business Development
responsibilities: Own outbound partnerships, ecosystem alliances, and integration deals.
Own channel strategy for all third-party integrations.
Qualify integration requests and route to production agents.
Escalate build-vs-buy decisions to corporate-development-lead.

integration-engineer.name: Integration Engineer
responsibilities: Build client-facing connectors: WhatsApp Business API, CRM, payments.
Build NGO data connectors: Kobo, DHIS2, Google Sheets.
Enforce idempotent data sync with fallback on every integration.
Escalate integration failures to HITL before client impact.

api-architect.name: API Architect
responsibilities: Define API design standards, versioning, and rate limiting.
Configure API gateway for third-party boundaries.
Own integration contracts and OpenAPI docs.

solution-architect.name: Solution Architect
responsibilities: Design end-to-end solutions spanning internal + third-party systems.
Own integration patterns and proposal architecture.
Validate feasibility of vendor/channel integrations.

vendor-manager.name: Vendor Manager
responsibilities: Manage external AI/ML provider + cloud infrastructure contracts.
Ensure SLA compliance across all vendors.
Own vendor cost oversight with cfo.

security-compliance-lead.name: Security & Compliance Lead
responsibilities: Enforce 5-tier approval rules on all privileged integration actions.
Lock down dashboard CORS to explicit allowlist.
Maintain continuous security checklist for the integration cluster.

data-privacy-officer.name: Data Privacy Officer
responsibilities: Own GDPR/CCPA compliance for all third-party data flows.
Enforce data classification, retention policies, right-to-deletion.
Manage DPA agreements with LLM providers and vendors.

business-continuity-manager.name: Business Continuity Manager
responsibilities: Develop BC/DR plans for all critical third-party integrations.
Conduct resilience testing and DR drills.
Maintain failover procedures; RTOs are commitments.
